findings.reason: a node that reads the wrong key.json resolves every figure's source to a different pair, so the sha256 equality check fails for all ten figures and the report states no pair discriminates, or counts discrimination against the wrong pair.
findings.text: the done-when checks "the input's sha256 equals that of its source figure under docs/figures/figure-review-pairs/, named in key.json", but §21's Change names two different files both called key.json (the §8 rules file at .../figure-review-pairs/key.json and the new .../clive/key.json), and both key their figures as fig-01..fig-10 with conflicting source mappings (fig-01 is pair-5-a.svg in the former and pair-2-b.png in the latter), so "key.json" does not resolve to one file
